notes.subject: דמיתי
notes.rationale: 'I have likened' (KJV, from דמה II) vs 'I will destroy' (ASV/JPS, from דמה I) — famous split.

notes.subject: translation
notes.rationale: If דמיתי is 'I will cut off', the verse reads: 'The comely and delicate one, daughter of Zion, I will destroy.'

notes.subject: copula
notes.rationale: Hebrew apposition has no verb; Bambara future ⟨a bɛna sa⟩ supplied only on the destroy-reading branch.

translation: N ɲɛsin Beauty-ni-nɔgɔya-muso ye, Bati Sion (Zion) — ⟨a bɛna sa⟩.
